visual_observations: Six distinct full ink silhouettes: many-handled jar keeper, frightened horn-grip athlete, flask painter, figure-eight-shield guard, ecstatic pigment painter and weary cargo carrier. Female-read cells 0 and 4 (zero-based).

The guard's helmet has a Greek/Roman-like crest, a period-mix deviation. Wraps and decorative motifs are fictional interpretations. Large uneven eyes and distinct closed, gritted, open and downturned mouths remain legible.
